question: What did Galileo conclude in 1638 on noticing that the square numbers pair off with all whole numbers?
answer: That equal, greater and less do not apply to infinite quantities. Squares thin out, 10 up to 100 and only 100 up to 10,000, yet every number n pairs with its square n². Galileo therefore stopped comparing. Cantor, some 240 years later, took the pairing itself as the meaning of equal size.
move: When a word stops working, choose between dropping it and redefining it.
reference: Galileo, Dialogues Concerning Two New Sciences, trans. Crew & de Salvio, Macmillan, 1914
